title: check-debt-ratchets
responsibility: Compares layer allowlist edges, reuse findings, and direct temporary-directory calls against Git-base inventories, failing when these debt measures grow.

inputs.name: layerRatchet.before
inputs.description: Layer edges from the comparison baseline.

inputs.name: layerRatchet.after
inputs.description: Layer edges in the current tree.

inputs.name: reuseRatchet.before
inputs.description: Per-path reuse finding counts from the comparison baseline.

inputs.name: reuseRatchet.after
inputs.description: Per-path reuse finding counts in the current tree.

inputs.name: mkdtempCallCount.source
inputs.description: TypeScript source text to inspect for direct mkdtemp and mkdtempSync calls imported from filesystem modules.

inputs.name: temporaryCallRatchet.before
inputs.description: Per-test-file direct temporary-directory call counts from the baseline.

inputs.name: temporaryCallRatchet.after
inputs.description: Per-test-file direct temporary-directory call counts in the current tree.

inputs.name: temporaryCallRatchet.helperPath
inputs.description: Shared helper path exempted from ordinary count growth and limited to one direct temporary-directory call; defaults to test/support/temporary.ts.

outputs.name: layerRatchet
outputs.type: { before: number; after: number; added: string[]; removed: string[] }
outputs.description: Unique-edge counts plus sorted edge additions and removals between baseline and current allowlists.

outputs.name: reuseRatchet
outputs.type: { before: number; after: number; added: string[]; reduced: string[] }
outputs.description: Total finding counts plus sorted per-path increases and reductions.

outputs.name: mkdtempCallCount
outputs.description: Number of recognized direct calls to imported mkdtemp or mkdtempSync functions.

outputs.name: temporaryCallRatchet
outputs.type: { before: number; after: number; added: string[] }
outputs.description: Total call counts plus sorted paths whose calls grew or whose shared helper exceeds its one-call limit.

errors.name: Debt baseline inspection failure
errors.description: Git base lookup, baseline reads, TypeScript/source file reads, or JSON parsing can throw before the growth result is reported.

inputs.description: Per-test-file direct temporary-directory call counts from the baseline.
